warning.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Sport SV / P635 Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The BMW S68 is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older BMW S68 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every BMW S68 rebuild.

Because the Range Rover Sport SV / P635 uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the Range Rover Sport 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established BMW S68 specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
